Profile the objective function over one model parameter

Source: R/nm_profile.R
nm_profile.Rd

Runs a series of NONMEM estimations in which a single $THETA is fixed to each value of a grid while every other parameter is re-estimated, yielding the profile of the objective function value (OFV, without the additive constant) for that parameter. The minimum of the curve locates the conditional estimate; the width at min(OFV) + ci_threshold gives an approximate likelihood-based confidence interval.

Usage

nm_profile(
  ctl,
  nmfe_path,
  param,
  from,
  to,
  by,
  output_dir = NULL,
  strip_tables = TRUE,
  strip_cov = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  ci_threshold = 3.84,
  digits = NULL,
  run = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  n_cores = 1L,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'nm_profile'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'nm_profile'
plot(x, type = c("ofv", "dofv"), ...)

Arguments

ctl

Path to the reference control file. (Formerly ctl_path, still accepted with a warning; the former order, nmfe_path first, is also recognised.)

nmfe_path

Path to the NONMEM launcher (e.g. nmfe76.bat on Windows, the nmfe76 script on Linux or macOS).

param

The parameter to profile: a $THETA label (matched whole-word, case-insensitive, e.g. "CL") or an index (3, "3", or "THETA(3)").

from, to, by

Numeric grid: first value, last value, and increment.

output_dir

Output directory. Defaults to <ctl_dir>/<ctl>_<param>_profile.

strip_tables, strip_cov

Logical; drop $TABLE / $COV from the generated controls. Both TRUE by default (recommended for a profile).

overwrite

Logical; if FALSE (default) a run whose .lst already exists and minimised successfully is skipped (resume after interruption).

ci_threshold

Numeric; delta-OFV cut-off for the interval. Default 3.84 (chi-square, 1 df, two-sided 95%). Set NA to disable. Note: for a variance component tested at its boundary (\(\omega^2=0\)) the appropriate one-sided cut-off is 2.71, not 3.84.

digits

Decimals used to format fixed values and run labels. Auto- derived from by when NULL.

run

Logical; if FALSE, generate the control files without launching NONMEM.

verbose

Logical; print progress messages (default TRUE). Formerly quiet (the opposite), still accepted with a warning.

n_cores

Number of grid values run at the same time (default 1). A whole number, "auto" (physical cores minus one, see nm_cores()) or "ask" (interactive sessions: the cores are shown and the number is asked once per R session, then reused; options(nmpilot.n_cores = NULL) asks again). Each run is then started in the background in its own directory; if R is interrupted, the runs already started go on in the background and a later call with the same arguments picks up their results.

...

Ignored.

x

An nm_profile object.

type

Which figure to draw: "ofv" (OFV vs value) or "dofv" (delta-OFV vs value, with the ci_threshold line).

Value

An object of class nm_profile: a list with results (a data frame of run, value, ofv, dOFV, min_ok, cov_ok, cov_warning, dir, lst), plus ci, min_ofv, min_value, param, param_safe, target, ci_threshold, and output_dir. Use print() for a summary and plot() (with type = "ofv" or "dofv") for figures.

Details

Only $DATA is remapped (to an absolute path) and $TABLE/$COV are stripped by default; every other record is preserved byte-for-byte. Each run is written to its own sub-directory under output_dir/runs/.

See also

nm_run(), nm_extract_runs(), nm_compare()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
prof <- nm_profile(
  ctl       = "C:/nm76g64/run/test/run_test.reg/run_test.ctl",
  nmfe_path = "C:/nm76g64/run/nmfe76.bat",
  param     = "CL", from = 0.1, to = 3, by = 0.05
)
prof                       # summary (print.nm_profile)
plot(prof)                 # OFV vs value
plot(prof, type = "dofv")  # dOFV vs value, with the 3.84 threshold
} # }
